newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark points finger at Israel over unrest.
newsitem.headline: Denmark points finger at Israel over unrest.

text.p: Denmark said on Thursday that lack of progress toward Middle East peace by Israel's government was a factor in a fresh outburst of clashes with Palestinians and Israel therefore bore much of the blame for the bloodshed.
Foreign Minister Niels Helveg Petersen, speaking to Danish news agency Ritzau during a visit to the United Nations in New York, said that the violence was tragic but not unexpected.

"Since the new Israeli government took office the peace process in the Middle East has not moved and the government bears a considerable part of the responsibility for the tragic developments," he said.
"The situation in Israel has been the subject of intense study in European Union circles here in New York," he added.

"We can only strongly urge the Israeli government to make a move and work to restart the peace process, we would at the same time ask all sides to show restraint in order to prevent further violence and bloodshed."
